notes.random: Each is compared with 200 random-entry runs at its own time in market: random intraday trades, never overlapping and closed by the session's last bar, with lengths drawn from that strategy's own trades and the same share of longs, paying the same costs.
notes.val: Not a clean test. These 4 were picked from the nb_es_v1 finalists using their 2023–2024 results (Sharpe, beats-luck, both years profitable) as well as 2018–2022, so 2023–2024 is in-sample for the choice. It shows the strategy held up; it can't prove it. The untouched test is the 2025+ holdout tab.
notes.holdout: Not a clean test: the noise-band holdout for ES was used 5 time(s) before this run. Treat these numbers as a check, not independent proof.
